wish: someone should make a Monopoly edition where inflation changes prices
spec: Two-player hot-seat property game on a 12-square loop: roll, buy, pay rent, collect salary passing Start.\nAfter every round a random inflation rate (-2% to +10%) rescales all prices, rents and salary; 20 rounds, richest wins, or a player going broke loses.\nIt does not do auctions, mortgages, houses or online play.
